svg.title: Clostridium sweep: directional asymmetry vs length gap
svg.desc: Scatter plot of target length minus mutable length against solver forward minus reverse move count for matched directional pairs.
svg.text: Figure 3. Directional asymmetry tracks the length gap almost linearly
Matched canonical pairs: 524; Pearson r = 0.90; mean |solver diff| = 7.34; mean |OrthoAlign diff| = 1.25
